acceptance_calibration.summary: v21 keeps v20's raw neural weights, ensemble members, weights, and temperatures. Only the acceptance calibration changed.
acceptance_calibration.min_confidence_by_language_and_length: Refit on the public validation split (100,175 rows; disjoint from train and test) and capped at v20's value, so v21 never rejects a confidence-accepted v20 sample; 94 (language, length) cells were lowered.
acceptance_calibration.min_margin_rule: An accepted prediction must also have (top1 probability - top2 probability) at or above the floor for its length group.
acceptance_calibration.fit_data: Public validation split and existing authored development sets only; no diagnostic test labels were used to fit thresholds or margins.

limitations: Repeated historical diagnostics informed adaptive development; this is not an independent test.
The public diagnostic is an adaptive benchmark, not independent certification.
The per-length top-2 margin floor is an operational cutoff, not a correctness guarantee.
One-sample coverage regression on the locked 64-message sample (55 vs 56 correct accepted, 0 accepted errors), caused by the margin floor.
Authored examples are correlated and assistant labels are not human-verified gold.
packaging: Runtime-required state only; lexical terms also present in public training text. Source application texts and working records not distributed.
